# UniversalComputation

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The capability of a network or substrate to implement any computable function, typically via reconfigurable or emergent dynamics. Establishes the functional ceiling for TCC architectures, motivating topology designs that support flexible, general-purpose computation across distributed nodes.
